name: Rapicut Carbides Limited
about: Rapicut Carbides Limited manufactures and sells tungsten carbide products in India and internationally. The company provides products for mining, including coal pick, conicals, pineapple bit, octagonal insert, chain saw, and other customized products; and bucket wheel excavation products, including ripper, solid triangle, and rectangular flat. It also offers tungsten carbide rotary burrs blanks, sugar tips, paper cutting knives, scarfer tools, and twist drills; and tungsten carbide for trepanning tool and form tools, and other cutters. In addition, the company provides tungsten carbide brazed tools, slitting cutters, reamers, and straight flute end mills; mechanical scissors or knives; and boring tools; and T-slot cutters and counter bore cutters. Further, it offers bowls, lids, ladle cleaning inserts, shear blades, hole punching dies, V-notch dies, brazed turning tools, expansion punches, seats and TC plugs/stems, mechanical seals rings, squeeze rolls/pressure rolls, chisels, and scarfer tools. Additionally, the company provides flow control valves, choke beans, valve seats, flow cages, and carbide tubes for oil and gas industries; cork cutting knives, scrapping tools, glass cutter discs, solid carbide rods, roto scarfs, and fin cutting products for cutting applications; and solid plug, semi floating plug, scarf tool, and sleeve parallel plug products for tube industries. Furthermore, it offers intermediate, tungsten, cobalt, and other powders, as well as provides wire drawing, bar and tube drawing pellets, and cold heading and bore pellets. The company serves metal cutting, mining, wear parts, and various other industries. Rapicut Carbides Limited was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Ankleshwar, India.
